channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Fred Hoiberg | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Fred Hoiberg from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kris Dunn on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Kris Dunn on Fred Hoiberg:

“When I came into the organization, he helped me get my swagger back.”

Kris Dunn on Fred Hoiberg, Dec 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
KC Johnson:Bulls exec VP John Paxson:

“It was made most difficult because all of us in this organization like Fred Hoiberg a lot. He had to deal with a lot of difficult circumstances. This decision wasn’t based on our record.”

John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg, Dec 3, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Tom Thibodeau on Fred Hoiberg's firing:

“It's a tough business. I hate to see that for anyone. It's one of the bad parts about the business when you see a coaching change. Fred is a good man. Wish him well going forward.”

Tom Thibodeau on Fred Hoiberg, Dec 3, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
KC Johnson:Paxson:

“(Hoiberg) has a style he wants to play. I think it's the way the game has evolved into---ball & player movement, playing w/ pace.”

John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg, Sep 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg, Denzel Valentine
item.description:
Mike McGraw:Paxson:

“We need Cam to play, we need Denzel to play, we need Bobby to play. He (Hoiberg) understands that and he's on board.”

John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg, Denzel Valentine, Feb 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @McGrawDHBulls.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Rondo:

“(Hoiberg) asks me all the time if I’m healthy. I respond the same, that this is the best I’ve ever felt at this part of the season.”

Rajon Rondo on Fred Hoiberg, Jan 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Rondo on Hoiberg's message to him:

“He told me that I've been looking slow the last five games.”

Rajon Rondo on Fred Hoiberg, Jan 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Butler on Hoiberg being on hot seat:

“We go out there, we play, we fight with him. It’s over my head. He ain’t on no hot seat to me.”

Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg, Dec 30, 2016. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
KC Johnson:Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg:

“I told Fred, 'As much as you can, use me as an example. I want you to really get on my tail about every little thing.'”

Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg, Sep 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
“I'm a grown man, first and foremost. But no, I wanted to play. That's that. [Hoiberg] came to me, he knew how to talk to me. He said, 'Hey, you may have to run point guard.' Ah, it's a wrap. Yeah, I'm playing now. He knew what to say to get me to really, really, really want to suit up, but I was going to play anyways.”

Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg, Apr 12, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Gar Forman on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Gar Forman on Fred Hoiberg:

“He’s extremely smart. He has great knowledge of the game. He’s got a good way with people. There are areas where he can grow.”

Gar Forman on Fred Hoiberg, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Gar Forman on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Gar Forman on Fred Hoiberg:

“I think Fred’s a very good basketball coach. He’s extremely sharp, communicates well and an extremely hard worker. That said he knows he needs to continue to grow. There’s bumps in the road. But we’re excited about the future.”

Gar Forman on Fred Hoiberg, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
KC Johnson:Portis on Hoiberg saying he'll stay in rotation:

“It really means nothing. I still have to work as hard as I can every day to get better.”

Bobby Portis on Fred Hoiberg, Jan 2, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Fred Hoiberg, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
KC Johnson:Joakim Noah on Jimmy Butler's comments:

“I just wish it would've been kept in-house, maybe. That would've probably been better. Everybody needs to be a leader. It's not about Jimmy. It’s not about Coach Hoiberg. It's about everybody coming w/ the right attitude”

Joakim Noah on Fred Hoiberg, Jimmy Butler, Dec 23, 2015. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
“We weren't doing what we were supposed to be doing — what we wrote up on that board before the game. Nobody spoke up about it. I did (but) probably not enough times. (Hoiberg) has to hold everybody accountable from the No. 1 player all the way down to however many guys we have. When you match up and do your job we'll win the game.”

Jimmy Butler on Fred Hoiberg, Dec 20, 2015. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Jeff Van Gundy on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Frank Isola:Jeff Van Gundy on Sirius XM regarding Bulls.

“Hopefully they treat their next head coach better. You know, Fred Hoiberg and his staff. Fred's a good man, and he's a good coach, and I hope he gets treated well. I hope he gets treated really well.”

Jeff Van Gundy on Fred Hoiberg, May 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @FisolaNYDN.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Tom Izzo, Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
“We talked to a lot of people, a lot of good people. Some college guys, [Michigan State’s] Tom Izzo is a friend of mine, [Iowa State’s] Freddie Hoiberg. When you go through that situation they have things they want to do. To coach at [the NBA] level is difficult because there’s a lot of factors that get involved. So when it came down to it and we started going through everybody, I went to Glen this week and I said, ‘Here’s some options we have.’ Then Glen said, based on where our team is right now, I think you’re the best viable option to coach this team and move forward.”

Flip Saunders on Tom Izzo, Fred Hoiberg, Jun 6, 2014. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Ronny Turiaf on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
Newest TimberwolfRonny Turiaf on Thursday officially signed with his seventh different team in nine NBA seasons, but he can’t help but think how his life has come full circle now.

“I remember eight years ago and you guys had somebody named Fred Hoiberg,”

Ronny Turiaf on Fred Hoiberg, Jul 19, 2013. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Ronny Turiaf on Fred Hoiberg
item.description:
“Of course, we still talk. It is not a one-way ticket for heart surgery, it is a lifetime bond we have. For me, that shows basketball is a game that transcends generations, that transcends colors. To have somebody like Fred Hoiberg and myself become partners in this crazy ordeal, it’s a wonderful thing for me.”

Ronny Turiaf on Fred Hoiberg, Jul 19, 2013. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.
